1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Original preprint introducing a meta-agent that jointly adapts the environment, user simulator, and agent-training process.  
   **People:** Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — independent researcher; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii).  
   **URL:** [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU paper review and breakdown** — An AI-generated critical review summarizing the method, results, compute-budget concerns, and reproducibility limitations.  
   **People/affiliations:** Same six paper authors and affiliations listed above; the review itself is published by Pith and is not human peer review.  
   **URL:** [Pith](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

3. **Min Cai’s research page** — Author page announcing EAU and listing it under agent training research.  
   **Person:** Min Cai — PhD student at the University of Alberta, advised by Xi Ye; previously a research intern at Baidu and Z.ai.  
   **URL:** [Min Cai](https://henrycai11.github.io/)

1. **arXiv paper — “EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents.”** Authors: Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (Independent Researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute/Amii). Submitted October 12, 2026. [https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **Official EAU project page.** Associated with the same six authors and affiliations; linked directly from the paper. [https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Pith paper page and AI-generated review.** Covers the work by Cai, Zhang, Xing, Ma, Xu, and Ye, with the affiliations listed above. The review highlights EAU’s reported gains but questions unmatched compute budgets and reproducibility. [https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **arXivDaily listing.** Indexes the same authors and identifies the participating organizations as the University of Alberta, National University of Singapore, Kuaishou Technology, and Amii; it omits Xu’s “Independent Researcher” designation. [https://www.arxivdaily.com/companies/kuaishou](https://www.arxivdaily.com/companies/kuaishou)

The search points to one primary research project, plus related pages about the same paper:

1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The primary arXiv paper. EAU is a meta-agent that adapts the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration during training.  
   **People/affiliations:** Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — National University of Singapore; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — Independent Researcher; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii).  
   URL: [arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU project website** — Companion project page linked directly from the paper.  
   **People/affiliations:** Same six-person research team and affiliations listed above.  
   URL: [eau-meta-agent.github.io](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Pith paper review and breakdown** — An independent AI-generated critique of EAU. It highlights the framework’s hot-swapping and cross-run experience reuse, while questioning unmatched compute budgets and reproducibility with a proprietary meta-agent.  
   **Paper authors/affiliations:** Min Cai — University of Alberta; Dan Zhang — NUS; Gao Xing and Libin Ma — Kuaishou Technology; Zhaohui Xu — Independent; Xi Ye — University of Alberta and Amii.  
   URL: [pith.science/paper/2610.16523](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)

4. **Min Cai’s research page** — Author page describing EAU as work on continually learning systems and co-evolving agents with their training environments.  
   **Person/affiliation:** Min Cai — PhD student at the University of Alberta, advised by Xi Ye.  
   URL: [henrycai11.github.io](https://henrycai11.github.io/)
